result_text:
The region overview now lists open support tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within the same priority. The full offline test suite passes. I didn't add a test for the new order, and I didn't run your T-1 to T-5 example.

The change is the `ORDER BY` in `DataStore.listOpenSupportTicketsInRegion` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`). It uses the same priority ordering as the sales rep's open-ticket list, and I updated the Javadoc to match. Closed tickets and tickets of other regions are still excluded as before. The region overview is the only place that calls this method.
